Preserve same playful winking young woman with messy brown high ponytail and loose strands, original brass goggles sitting in her hair, same funny handheld brass machine topped by a spring and little yellow rubber duck, original tiny wrench/tools, glass vials and rolled plans. Keep exact face and mischievous happy expression.

Footwear: burnt-orange enclosed rubber workshop clogs with a simple heel strap, rounded protective toes and shallow black soles, gray ribbed ankle socks. Not lace-up boots, not heels or sneakers. Quirky practical workshop silhouette with the same tiny inventor details.
